content.heading: Comment references
content.body: Point code back at requirements — same graph, other door.

slides.notes: File references point requirements at code. Comment references reverse the arrow.

content.heading: The rq: token
content.body: Lives in comments, so it works across languages.

slides.notes: The prefix rq: marks the token for tooling.

content.heading: Round-trip traceability
content.body: Requirements → files. Files → requirements. Both stay in the graph.

slides.notes: Same graph, entered from the implementation side.
